summary: A heavy legal and regulatory day dominated by enforcement actions and court rulings affecting retail operations. ED custody order in major money laundering case and beverage industry challenge to food labeling ban create significant compliance exposure.

bullets.text: Ozone Group Chairman remanded to 14-day ED custody in ₹927 crore money laundering investigation.
PepsiCo and Monster Beverage initiated legal challenge against India's food regulator energy drink labeling ban.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030, up from current levels.
Sensex and Nifty fell for eight consecutive weeks, erasing ₹26 lakh crore in market capitalisation.
US 10-year Treasury yield surged to 5.34%, highest level since 2002, impacting emerging markets.
